M3.text: Somewhere, a little snow slips from a branch and falls with a soft hush into the deep white below.

M4.text: Far across the slopes, the lights of a snow groomer move slowly, a tiny glow crawling through the dark.

M5.text: Deep in the forest and owl calls once and the woods go quiet again.

N1.text: The cabin slows, the snow drifts past the glass, soft and slow.

N2.text: Higher and quieter and slower still.

N3.text: Only the wind and the quiet hum carrying you up.

N4.text: snow and stillness and the gentle climb.
